display_title: See You at the Library of Reunion!
description:
An afterlife library that stores the stories of the dead, and if you find a book of someone you want to see there, you can meet them again, even if they are dead, so it is also called the 'Library of Reunion'. Soo-chan accidentally enters the library and meets the librarian Nam-gung Yeong. Yeong-i tells Soo-chan that if he helps her make her own book, she will find his mother's book for him... Will Soo-chan be able to meet his mother again in the library?

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=834195), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11850048)
